theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 12 群

items.colloc: a stamped envelope 貼好郵票的信封 | seal an envelope 封好信封
items.distinct: package 包裹 | folder 資料夾
ex: Please put the contract in the envelope.
請把合約放進信封裡。
She sealed the envelope before leaving.
她在離開前封好了信封。
You need to write your address on the envelope.
你需要把地址寫在信封上。

items.colloc: eventually lead to 終將導致 | eventually succeed 最終成功
items.distinct: finally 最後（強調順序）| possibly 可能
ex: The company will eventually expand to overseas markets.
公司最終會擴展至海外市場。
They eventually reached an agreement after long talks.
經過長談後，他們最終達成協議。
Poor planning will eventually cause serious delays.
規劃不善最終會導致嚴重的延誤。

items.colloc: provide evidence 提供證據 | clear evidence 明顯的證據
items.distinct: proof 證明（不可數）| clue 線索
ex: We found no evidence of any technical errors.
我們沒發現任何技術錯誤的跡象。
The documents serve as evidence for our claims.
這些文件作為我們主張的證據。
Marketing research provides evidence for this strategy.
市場研究為此策略提供了證據。

items.pos: adj. 感到興奮的；激動的
items.colloc: be excited about 對...感到興奮 | get excited 變得激動
items.distinct: exciting 令人興奮的（修飾事物）| enthusiastic 熱情的
ex: The staff is excited about the new project.
全體員工對新專案感到興奮。
We are excited to announce our annual results.
我們很高興宣布年度業績。
Everyone felt excited during the award ceremony.
頒獎典禮期間每個人都感到很激動。

items.colloc: expect to do 期望做某事 | highly expected 高度期待的
items.distinct: anticipate 預期（指心裡預先體驗）| hope 希望
ex: Management expects to see higher profits this quarter.
管理層預期本季獲利會更高。
We expect all employees to arrive on time.
我們期望所有員工準時到達。
The CEO is expected to retire next year.
執行長預計明年退休。

items.colloc: explore options 探討選項 | explore possibilities 探索可能性
items.distinct: examine 檢查 | investigate 調查
ex: We need to explore new marketing channels.
我們需要探討新的行銷管道。
Let us explore all potential business opportunities.
讓我們探索所有潛在的商業機會。
The team will explore ways to reduce costs.
團隊將探討降低成本的方法。

items.colloc: extensive research 廣泛的研究 | extensive experience 豐富的經驗
items.distinct: intensive 密集的 | expensive 昂貴的
ex: She has extensive experience in international trade.
她在國際貿易方面擁有豐富經驗。
The building suffered extensive damage during the storm.
這棟建築在風暴中遭受了嚴重破壞。
Extensive training is required for this position.
這個職位需要接受廣泛的培訓。

items.colloc: extremely difficult 非常困難 | extremely important 極為重要
items.distinct: highly 高度地 | absolutely 絕對地
ex: It is extremely important to meet the deadline.
準時完成期限極為重要。
The office is extremely busy during peak seasons.
旺季期間辦公室極為忙碌。
This new software is extremely user friendly.
這套新軟體非常好用。

items.pos: n. 檔案；文件 | v. 歸檔；提出（申請）
items.colloc: file a report 提交報告 | paper file 紙本檔案
items.distinct: document 文件（內容）| record 紀錄
ex: Please file these documents in the cabinet.
請把這些文件歸檔到櫃子裡。
He needs to file a tax return today.
他今天需要申報所得稅。
The digital file was sent via email.
電子檔案已透過電子郵件寄出。

items.colloc: frequently asked questions 常見問題 | occur frequently 頻繁發生
items.distinct: often 經常 | regularly 定期地
ex: We frequently review our current safety policies.
我們頻繁地審查現行的安全政策。
Train delays occur frequently in this region.
該地區火車經常誤點。
Check the frequently asked questions for support.
查看常見問題集以獲得支援。

items.colloc: be grateful for 對...感到感激 | deeply grateful 深深感激
items.distinct: thankful 感激的 | pleasant 愉快的
ex: We are grateful for your continued support.
我們很感激您持續的支持。
I am grateful to the team for their hard work.
我很感激團隊付出的努力。
She sent a note to express how grateful she was.
她寫了便條表達她的感激之情。

items.colloc: break a habit 改掉壞習慣 | develop a habit 養成習慣
items.distinct: custom 風俗；習俗 | routine 例行公事
ex: It is a good habit to check your emails daily.
每天檢查電子郵件是個好習慣。
Breaking bad habits takes time and patience.
改掉壞習慣需要時間與耐心。
He developed the habit of arriving early for meetings.
他養成了提早開會的習慣。

items.pos: n. 負責人；主管 | v. 領導；朝向
items.colloc: head of department 部門主管 | head a team 領導團隊
items.distinct: chief 首長 | director 董事；總監
ex: She will head the new research department.
她將負責領導新的研發部門。
Who is the head of the marketing team?
行銷團隊的負責人是誰？
The director decided to head to the conference room.
總監決定前往會議室。

items.colloc: health insurance 健康保險 | public health 公共衛生
items.distinct: condition 狀況 | fitness 健身；合適
ex: The company offers excellent health insurance benefits.
公司提供優良的健康保險福利。
Good health is essential for high productivity.
良好的健康對於高生產力至關重要。
Regular breaks can help improve office health.
定期休息有助於改善辦公室健康狀況。

items.colloc: hold a meeting 舉行會議 | hold a position 擔任職位
items.distinct: keep 保持（持續）| contain 包含
ex: The conference room can hold fifty people.
這間會議室可以容納五十人。
We will hold the annual meeting next week.
我們下週將舉行年度會議。
Please hold the line while I connect you.
請稍候，我為您轉接電話。

items.colloc: immediately available 立即有空 | act immediately 立即行動
items.distinct: promptly 迅速地 | currently 目前
ex: Please contact the IT department immediately.
請立刻聯繫資訊部門。
The problem was solved immediately after reporting.
問題在報告後立刻得到了解決。
I will send the files immediately upon arrival.
我到達後會立刻寄出檔案。

items.colloc: impressive performance 傑出的表現 | impressive results 驚人的成果
items.distinct: expressive 表達的 | aggressive 積極的
ex: The candidate has an impressive professional background.
該候選人擁有令人印象深刻的背景。
They achieved impressive sales growth this year.
他們今年達成了驚人的銷售成長。
Your presentation was very impressive to the clients.
您的簡報讓客戶印象深刻。

items.colloc: improve efficiency 提升效率 | improve communication 加強溝通
items.distinct: enhance 提升（品質）| repair 修理
ex: We must improve our customer service quality.
我們必須改善客戶服務品質。
The new system should improve office efficiency.
新系統應該能改善辦公效率。
I hope to improve my English skills soon.
我希望盡快提升我的英文技巧。

items.colloc: invest in 投資於... | invest money 投入資金
items.distinct: spend 花費 | deposit 存款
ex: They decided to invest in solar energy technology.
他們決定投資太陽能技術。
Many companies invest heavily in employee training.
許多公司在員工培訓上投入重金。
You should invest wisely for your future retirement.
為了退休，你應該明智地投資。

items.pos: n. 議題；問題；期刊 | v. 發行；核發
items.colloc: key issue 關鍵議題 | resolve an issue 解決問題
items.distinct: problem 問題（負面）| matter 事項
ex: We need to discuss this issue at the meeting.
我們需要在會議上討論這個議題。
The bank will issue new credit cards today.
銀行將於今日發行新信用卡。
There is a minor issue with the software program.
軟體程式有一個小問題。
